fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the execution of Dnx.EXE. The Dnx utility allows for the execution of C# code.
Attackers might abuse this in order to bypass application whitelisting.
fields.name: Potential Application Whitelisting Bypass via Dnx.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\dnx.exe")
